text:
violet: quick Q — I use a personal MacBook Air (M2). Do I have to MDM-enroll it to take the phishing sim and access the wiki? Also curious about whether FileVault can be deferred for a few days.

jamie: welcome! phishsim targets accounts so you'll get it either way. MDM is only required for company devices; personal OK but with limited app access. FileVault is required on company devices; defer only in special cases — ping @sam-security with the reason.

it-help: If you later enroll macOS, steps: Company Portal -> SSO -> Install "Redwood MDM" -> Enable FileVault. If enrollment fails, collect the error screenshot and we'll open a ticket.

sam-security: Note: contractors with access to customer data must be on enrolled devices and complete Security Essentials + sign AUP. Phishsim starts day 3; if you click we give a micro-remediation. DM me with privacy concerns.

onboard-bot: reminder: complete Security Essentials course within 7 days, enable MFA, and confirm device encryption.

violet: thanks — I'll wait for the laptop and DM if I need an exception.
